intro.text: A farmer in the Elendel Basin, arrested for blowing up a dam near Corbeau.

items.text: In 342 PC Johnst used explosives to destroy a dam near Corbeau. The flood killed dozens, wiped out crops and led to grain shortages. He said he had only meant to ruin his neighbour's harvest and that the blast was bigger than he intended.

At his trial he acted strangely and couldn't remember his children's names. His lawyers pleaded insanity, but he was sentenced to hang; he turned down a last meal and asked to get it over with. Two days after his burial his grave was desecrated, supposedly by relatives of the flood's victims.
From his story, Marasi and MeLaan concluded that Bleeder had killed Johnst and taken his place, using him to stir up more chaos in the Basin.
